name: island-verge-movement-check
js: (()=>{document.body.classList.add('film');const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY;let count=0,maxError=0;for(let x=900;x<1800;x+=7)for(let z=1700;z<2600;z+=7){const s=C.islandVergeSurfaceAt?.(x,z);if(!s)continue;for(const mode of ['person','cyclist','car']){const h=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,mode,s.h),error=Math.abs(h-s.h);maxError=Math.max(maxError,error);if(error>.000001)throw Error('Ground mismatch '+JSON.stringify({x,z,mode,s,h,error}));}count++;}if(count<100)throw Error('Too few built ramps '+count);console.log('[island-verge-movement] '+JSON.stringify({count,maxError,stats:C.islandVergeRampStats(),meshRaycast:'verified separately on high detail; phone CPU copies intentionally released'}));return{count,maxError};})()
